Investegate | Company Announcement Fundraise Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Net Asset Value(s) Merchants Trust PLC 19 September 2005 The Merchants Trust plc The Merchants Trust PLC announces that at close of business on 16 September 2005: 1) based on the book value of the company's long term debt and preference shares, its net asset value per ordinary share was 449.78p; and 2) based on the market value of the company's long term debt and preference shares, its net asset value per ordinary share was 416.08p. The market values of the company's long term debt and preference shares are based on closing Stock Exchange Daily Official List prices (with the exception of the 2029 5.875% debenture stock where the market value is derived by applying an interest rate that represents a suitable premium over a comparable gilt) and are updated monthly. Enquiries: Kirsten Salt Tel: 020 7065 1513 19 September 2005
